pr.title: fix(gateway): accept text field for OpenAI SDK 6.x parity
pr.body:
## Summary

- Add `text` field to `CreateResponseBodySchema` to accept OpenAI SDK 6.x's `text` parameter
- Previously, requests with the `text` key were rejected with `Unrecognized key: text` due to `.strict()` schema validation

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify schema accepts `text` field with format type `text`
- [ ] Verify schema accepts `text` field with format type `json_object`
- [ ] Verify schema accepts `text` field with format type `json_schema`
- [ ] Verify schema still rejects unknown keys
pr.author: dlrik

files.patch:
@@ -214,6 +214,21 @@ export const CreateResponseBodySchema = z
       })
       .optional(),
     truncation: z.enum(["auto", "disabled"]).optional(),
+    text: z
+      .object({
+        format: z.discriminatedUnion("type", [
+          z.object({ type: z.literal("text") }),
+          z.object({
+            type: z.literal("json_schema"),
+            json_schema: z
+              .object({ name: z.string(), description: z.string().optional() })
+              .strict(),
+          }),
+          z.object({ type: z.literal("json_object") }),
+        ]),
+        verbosity: z.enum(["auto", "verbose"]).optional(),
+      })
+      .optional(),
   })
   .strict();
